# Atla

> Atla is a senior-led branding studio founded by José Pablo Domínguez (Founder & Creative Director). It builds brand strategy, identity, packaging and digital systems for companies across the United States and Latin America. The team works from Austin, Mexico City, Barcelona, Lima and Caracas. The legal entity is Atla & WeLoveDaily, LLC (Austin, Texas).

## Studio

- [About](https://www.atla.design/about): who Atla is, the team, services and selected clients
- [Services](https://www.atla.design/services): brand strategy, identity design, digital design, motion, packaging, art direction, copywriting and tone of voice
- [How we work](https://www.atla.design/how-we-work): the engagement model from discovery to launch
- [Brand strategy](https://www.atla.design/brand-strategy): how Atla approaches positioning and messaging

## Services

Six disciplines, one team. Each link opens that discipline on the services page.

- [Strategy](https://www.atla.design/services#strategy): What the brand stands for, said in a way the whole company can repeat.
- [Naming and voice](https://www.atla.design/services#naming): The name, and the way the brand talks once it has one.
- [Identity](https://www.atla.design/services#identity): A system your team can run without us: logo, type, color, the rules.
- [Packaging](https://www.atla.design/services#packaging): The brand where it is held, opened and kept.
- [Website and decks](https://www.atla.design/services#website): The places the brand has to convince someone on its own.
- [Motion and campaigns](https://www.atla.design/services#motion): The brand in movement: the logo, the feed, the product.

The moments Atla is hired for. Each link starts a brief with that moment answered:

- [Launch](https://www.atla.design/brief?moment=launch)
- [Raise capital](https://www.atla.design/brief?moment=raise)
- [Grow / scale](https://www.atla.design/brief?moment=grow)
- [Reposition](https://www.atla.design/brief?moment=reposition)
